For the similarly named

*Honest Hearts*quest, see Gone Fishin'.

***Gone Fission*** is the twenty-third major update for *Fallout 76*. It was released on June 3, 2025. It was preceded by *Ghoul Within* [1] [2] and was followed by *C.A.M.P. Revamp*.

The update includes the fishing gameplay mechanic, as well as the twenty-first season, also named *Gone Fission*.

## Features[]

The full patch notes for *Gone Fission* can be found here.

- Season 21: *Gone Fission*
- Fishing gameplay mechanic
- Players who fast travel to Scorched Earth no longer spawn in the middle of the blast zone; instead they spawn near Drop Site V9
- Combat, enemies, weapons and mods rebalancing
 - More enemies are no longer immune to crippling
- Perk cards are no longer required for crafting weapons or making workshop traps, due to the annoyance of having to temporarily change loadouts
- Many perk card changes and re-naming:
 - Science > Science!
 - Science Expert > Pyro-Technician
 - Science Master > Cryologist
 - Rifleman > Down Ranger
 - Rifleman Expert > Scoped-up
 - Rifleman Master > Smart Shot
 - Commando > Center Masochist
 - Commando Expert > Fast Fighter
 - Commando Master > Number Cruncher
 - Shotgunner > Easy Target
 - Shotgunner Expert > Love the Spread
 - Shotgun Master > Shotgun Champ
